title: Staging Bench Slot Retention on Cancelled Network and Server Orders
content:
**Bench note.** The bench retention of a deposit credit, the Hardware Procurement deposit credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, follows the calendar days from the order's purchase order date to its cancellation date, an order not yet cancelled counting none:

1. for at most **2** days the bench slot is released and nothing is retained;
2. for more than 2 and fewer than **14** days the bench retention is the staging charge for the units ordered times those days divided by 14;
3. for 14 days or more the whole staging charge for the units ordered is retained.

The staging charge for the units ordered is the order type's staging fee per unit times the units ordered: 145.00 USD a unit on a Network Equipment Order, 395.00 USD a unit on a Server & Storage Build Order. The purchase order date and the cancellation date are those on the order's own record.

| Days from purchase order to cancellation | Bench retention |
|---|---|
| none (not yet cancelled) | nothing |
| 0, 1 or 2 | nothing |
| 3 to 13 | the staging charge times the days, divided by 14 |
| 14 or more | the whole staging charge |

### Worked example (hypothetical Network Equipment Order of 4 units, staging charge 580.00)

| Days | Retention |
|---|---|
| 2 | nothing |
| 7 | 580.00 times 7 divided by 14, that is 290.00 |
| 14 | 580.00 |
